concepts.definition: Nonrelativistic electron accelerated from negligible initial kinetic energy through voltage magnitude U; e > 0 is the charge magnitude and eU ≪ mₑc².
Electrons form interference/diffraction patterns, demonstrating wave properties of matter.
An electron with momentum p has matter wavelength λ=h/p.
concepts.when_to_use: p is momentum magnitude and k=2π/λ.
